name: frames
expr: [(f.Text.String, f.FillStyle.value, f.FillColor, f.FillGradient.StartColor, f.FillGradient.EndColor, f.BackColor, f.BackTransparent) for n in doc.TextFrames.ElementNames for f in [doc.TextFrames.getByName(n)]]

name: table
expr: [(c, t.getCellByName(c).BackColor, t.getCellByName(c).BackTransparent) for t in [doc.TextTables.getByIndex(0)] for c in ('A1','B1','A2')] + [doc.TextTables.getByIndex(0).BackColor]

name: paras
expr: [(p.String, p.ParaBackColor, p.ParaBackTransparent) for e in [doc.Text.createEnumeration()] for p in iter(lambda: e.nextElement() if e.hasMoreElements() else None, None) if p.supportsService('com.sun.star.text.Paragraph')]
